text: Al Ain Museum · Visitor experience roles
Apply for front-of-house roles at Al Ain Museum. Answer a few eligibility questions, then talk with our AI interviewer for about 10 minutes — in Arabic or English.
A 10-minute voice interview with an AI interviewer
A reply by e-mail within 5 working days
A quiet place and a working microphone
Chrome, Edge or Safari on a phone or laptop
Interview audio is not shared outside DCT
No account needed. Your answers are used only for this application and deleted after 12 months.
